description: List MCP server components carrying a supply-chain malware finding. Use to check whether anything in the register is flagged before installing.

status.description: Which findings to return: active, unverified, cleared or all. Defaults to active.

name: list_known_malware

clearedOn.description: Cleared rows only: first clean day.

code.description: The reason code recorded for the finding.

critical.description: Vendor graded it critical, which floors the component's score to zero.

firstFlaggedOn.description: UTC day OUR scan first recorded it. Not a vendor detection date; no vendor publishes one.

flaggedOnOrBefore.description: It was already present on the oldest reading we hold, so it began on or before that day.

lastCheckedOn.description: Newest day we hold any reading for this component.

lastConfirmedOn.description: Most recent UTC day a finding was confirmed.

llmOnly.description: Every indicator is a model's suspicion with no signature match. Report it as suspicion, never as a detection.

registryDeleted.description: The registry has since dropped this server.

score.description: The component's trust score; null when never scored.

serverName.description: Display name of the affected server.

serverSlug.description: Pass to get_server for the full report.

severity.description: Vendor severity; null when none was given.

state.description: active: still flagged. unverified: the finding was replaced by an inconclusive read. cleared: a later scan came back clean.

url.description: Canonical page carrying the full breakdown.

vendorUrl.description: The vendor's own report, when it indexes this ecosystem.

versionChecked.description: Version the verdict pertained to; null when the scan recorded none.

notice.description: How to narrow a truncated result, or why an empty one is empty; null when neither applies.

source.description: Canonical verifymcp.io page for this result.

title: List known malware
